real_economy.text: The US economy continues to grow at a solid pace, supported by resilient consumer spending and strong business investment, particularly in AI. GDP growth eased slightly in the second quarter, but underlying domestic demand strengthened, with higher imports weighing on overall growth.

sources.title: Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates

consumer_spending.text: US consumer spending remains resilient as stock market gains boost wealth among higher-income households, but slower income growth is prompting households to dip into savings to sustain spending.

investments.text: US business investment remains strong, largely driven by AI spending on data centers and computing equipment.

sources.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
